skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the concepts of data structures and algorithms, their performance, methods of algorithm representation, design techniques, and application techniques.
Understand the concept of array data structure and apply algorithms to process array data.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Stack and Queue Data Structure Understanding
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the concept of stack and queue data structures and apply algorithms to process list data.
Understand the concept of tree data structure and apply algorithms to process tree data.
Understand the concept of graph data structure and apply algorithms to process graph data.
Understand sorting algorithms and apply them to sort data.
Understand search algorithms and apply methods for searching.
Understand the concept of external processing and evaluate external processing algorithms.
Possess the ability to design and present algorithms, write reports on analyzing and representing algorithms on various data structures.
Possess the ability to independently learn about data structures and algorithms.
Possess the ability to work independently or actively participate in group activities.
Possess social responsibility and professional ethics in the field of information management systems.
